scope: Two map presentation notices and discovery guide stops; no fluent review claimed.

entries.source: AI maps on plain paper keep illustrated ground instead of flat overlays.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI ephepheni elimhlophe agcina umhlaba odwetshiwe esikhundleni sezendlalelo eziyisicaba.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa AI tse pampiring e tshweu di boloka mobu o takilweng ho e-na le dikarolo tse bataletseng.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya AI eka phepha ro basa yi hlayisa misava leyi dirowiweke ematshan'weni ya swiphemu swo andlaleka.
drafts.ve: Mapa dza AI kha bammbiri ḽitshena dzi vhulunga mavu o oliwaho nṱhani ha zwipiḓa zwo ṱanḓavhuwaho.

entries.source: Full-screen maps fit your phone, including with larger text.

drafts.zu: Amamephu esikrini esigcwele angena kahle ocingweni lwakho, ngisho nombhalo omkhulu.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa skrine se felletseng di lekana fonong ya hao, le ha mongolo o le moholo.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya xikirini lexi heleleke yi nghena kahle eka riqingho ra wena, hambi ku ri ni matsalelo lamakulu.
drafts.ve: Mapa a tshikirini tsho ḓalaho a lingana na luṱingo lwaṋu, na musi maḽeḓere e mahulwane.

entries.source: Open a saved map full-screen. The whole sheet and legend should fit.

drafts.zu: Vula imephu egciniwe esikrinini esigcwele. Lonke ishidi nezincazelo zezimpawu kufanele kungene.
drafts.st: Bula mmapa o bolokilweng skrineng se felletseng. Leqephe lohle le tlhaloso ya matshwao di lokela ho lekana.
drafts.ts: Pfula mepe lowu hlayisiweke eka xikirini hinkwaxo. Phepha hinkwaro ni tinhlamuselo ta swikombiso swi fanele ku nghena.
drafts.ve: Vulani mapa o vhulungwaho kha tshikirini tsho ḓalaho. Siaṱari ḽoṱhe na ṱhalutshedzo ya zwiga zwi tea u lingana.

drafts.st: Fumana hape setshwantsho seo o se lefileng
drafts.ts: Vuyisa xifaniso lexi u xi hakeleke

entries.source: Choose Reassemble artwork at the original print quality. No new AI render is bought.

drafts.zu: Khetha ukuhlanganisa umdwebo kabusha ngekhwalithi yokuphrinta yasekuqaleni. Awuthengi umdwebo omusha we-AI.
drafts.st: Kgetha ho kopanya setshwantsho hape ka boleng ba pele ba kgatiso. Ha o reke setshwantsho se setjha sa AI.
drafts.ts: Hlawula ku hlanganisa xifaniso nakambe hi khwalithi yo sungula ya ku kandziyisa. A wu xavi xifaniso lexintshwa xa AI.
drafts.ve: Khethani u kuvhanganya tshifanyiso hafhu nga vhuimo ha u gandisa ha u thoma. A hu rengwi tshifanyiso tshiswa tsha AI.
